pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with rounded vertices. Edge transitions exhibit smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp, high-contrast boundaries. Patch area is significantly larger on the lower neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space mesh of light-tan pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-point intersections. Pathways maintain a narrow and relatively consistent pixel thickness relative to the adjacent patch diameters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, bristled mane along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder. The 1D geometric contour presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the sky background.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical skin fold or anatomical crease is visible on the mid-torso, extending from the shoulder-flank junction toward the ventral region.
